assessment: This valuable study shows that the core PCP pathway, which commonly orients morphogenetic processes in development, does not establish global cues for cellular movements in the Drosophila pupal wing. Using a combination of laser-ablation experiments and mathematical modelling, it provides compelling evidence that the core PCP pathway only affects the fast timescale cellular response, but does not appear to drive overall tissue dynamics. While the signalling pathway guiding this morphogenetic process remains to be elucidated, these relevant findings challenge the role of the core PCP pathway in morphogenesis.
